mapper.select: SELECT A.OBJECT_ID, A.S_INFO_WINDCODE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.F_INFO_BGNDATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd') F_INFO_BGNDATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.F_INFO_ENDDATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd') F_INFO_ENDDATE, A.F_INFO_UNITYIELD, A.F_ACCUNITNAV, A.F_INCOME_PER_MILLION, A.F_INFO_YEARLYROE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.ANN_DATE,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd') ANN_DATE FROM CMONEYMARKETDAILYFINCOME A WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT B WHERE B.FINPROD_TYPE='F06' AND A.S_INFO_WINDCODE = B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID ) AND A.ANN_DATE = #{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
